steps.what: Run the scheduled backup of network data
Check the finished network backup result

tasks.design: The specialist backs up network data. The scheduled backup in {DATA_PLATFORM} already runs, and that runtime is not the specialist's time. The specialist still checks the result at full effort. A blank finish stays blank.
tasks.previous_blocker: The specialist checked a backup that a schedule already ran.
tasks.enabler_now: The schedule already runs. Checking the result is still the specialist's work.
tasks.still_hard: Deciding that a backup is fit to keep stays with the specialist.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist rejects a backup whose finish time is blank.
tasks.altitude: The backup schedule is not new labour. The check stays at full effort.

reach.task: Hear when a backup check failed
reach.learn: Which backups had a blank finish.

evidence.claim: A scheduled network backup already runs. Checking its result stays manual.

assumptions: The work starts when a backup finishes and ends when the specialist has checked it or stopped.
A backup result has backup identifier, start, finish, and byte count, written by the schedule. A blank finish is left blank.
The schedule's runtime is not counted as the specialist's time. Upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Which backups the specialist must check the same day.
research_questions: How often was the finish time blank, so the specialist could not accept the backup?

already_counted.description: Checking the backup result is already in the specialist's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: the schedule already runs.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every backup is still checked by the specialist. High: the same check remains, and the schedule's runtime is not counted. No upkeep is added, so the low does not go below zero. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Configure security settings and access permissions

steps.what: Configure security settings for groups or individuals
Set access permissions for those groups or individuals
Review the access permissions before they are written

tasks.design: The specialist configures security settings or access permissions for groups or individuals. {OPS_SYSTEM} does not choose who receives access. It writes only the permission list the specialist has accepted. A blank permission stays blank and is not granted.
tasks.previous_blocker: The specialist chose the permission and then retyped it.
tasks.enabler_now: A stored permission name can be written after the specialist accepts that exact list.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing security settings and access stays with the specialist.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist refuses access the request does not support.
tasks.altitude: Access is written only after the specialist accepts that version. The choice stays theirs.

evidence.claim: Writing an accepted permission list can be a later step. Choosing access stays manual.

The specialist who sets access remains responsible for it. Systematising staff access may need a works-council consultation before it is extended. The applicable rules are those in force for this organisation.

assumptions: The work starts with an access request and ends when the accepted permissions are written, or the specialist stops.
A permission proposal has group identifier or person identifier, and permission name, entered by the specialist. A blank permission is left blank and is not granted.
The write uses the list accepted in the review. It does not decide access.
unknowns: Which permission names this organisation allows a specialist to grant.
research_questions: How often did the specialist refuse access because the request did not support it?

already_counted.description: Setting access permissions is already in the specialist's step.

incremental.description: Correct a permission name before the list is accepted.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: requests are often too thin, so the specialist still decides access. High: the permission names are complete, the specialist reviews them, and only the accepted list is written. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List stored rows of computer network security breaches
Analyze attempted breaches and decide the report
Review the breach report before publication

tasks.design: The specialist analyzes and reports computer network security breaches or attempted breaches. {DATA_PLATFORM} lists stored rows only. A blank breach type stays blank and stops the list. The specialist decides the report. Publishing does not close the breach. Only the accepted report is published.
tasks.previous_blocker: The specialist gathered breach rows and wrote the report by hand.
tasks.enabler_now: Stored breach rows can be listed. The report is still the specialist's.
tasks.still_hard: Judging an attempted breach, and what the report says, stays with the specialist.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist refuses a report that treats a blank type as a breach.
tasks.altitude: The report is published only after the specialist accepts that version. The breach is not closed by the publication.

reach.learn: Which breaches the lead says are still open.

evidence.claim: Stored breach rows can be listed. The analysis and the report stay manual until the specialist accepts a version.
The specialist who signs a breach report remains responsible for it. The applicable rules are those in force for this organisation.

assumptions: The work starts with a period and ends when the accepted report is published, or the specialist stops. Publication does not close the breach.
A breach row has time, source address, and breach type, entered by the specialist from the alert. A blank type is left blank and is not invented.
Publication uses the report accepted in the review.
unknowns: Which breach types must be escalated before a report is accepted.
research_questions: How often did a blank breach type stop the list?

already_counted.description: Analyzing attempted breaches is already in the specialist's step.

incremental.description: Correct a breach type before the report is accepted.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: breach types are often blank, so the specialist still writes the report. High: rows are complete, the specialist analyzes and reviews, and only the accepted report is published. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Open stored diagnostic testing software results
Identify the causes of networking problems using equipment

tasks.design: The specialist identifies the causes of networking problems, using diagnostic testing software and equipment. {OPS_SYSTEM} only opens a stored result. A blank reading stays blank. Opening it does not shorten the identification, which stays at full effort. The result does not name the cause.
tasks.previous_blocker: The specialist opened the test software and then identified the cause on the equipment.
tasks.enabler_now: A stored result can be opened. The cause is still identified by the specialist.
tasks.still_hard: Naming the cause stays with the specialist, on the equipment.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist does not name a cause the reading does not support.
tasks.altitude: The identification stays at full effort. The screen only opens the stored result.

reach.task: Pass on the symptom the user reported

evidence.claim: A stored test identifier can open a diagnostic result. Identifying the cause stays manual.

assumptions: The work starts with a networking problem and ends when the specialist has named a cause or stopped.
A test result has test identifier, reading, and equipment identifier, entered by the specialist from the test. A blank reading is left blank.
Opening the result does not shorten the identification. The result does not name the cause.
unknowns: Which problems must be escalated before a cause is closed.
research_questions: How often was the reading blank, so the specialist went back to the equipment?

already_counted.description: Identifying the causes is already in the specialist's step.

incremental.description: Correct an equipment identifier on a result the specialist has rechecked.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: readings are often blank, so the identification is unchanged. High: the result opens, and the specialist still identifies the cause. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The specialist still decides access, diagnoses a fault, and signs a change. A permission list, report, or document is written or published only after the specialist accepts that version.
reach: An operations lead receives only a network report the specialist has accepted.
A service desk colleague receives only a request record the specialist has accepted.
skills_to_grow: Stop when a required counter, field, or resolution is blank.
Accept or refuse the exact version before a write or a publication.
Keep diagnosis, access decisions, and physical work in their own hands.
role.ambitious_version: Every monthly network report traces to a stored counter, and the specialist still signs the exception.
